summary: Keep the Go directive at the repo .go-version floor and golang.org/x/net at v0.62.0 so reachable stdlib and x/net vulnerabilities stay fixed when the CLI is built.
reason: Publish-time govulncheck on go 1.26.9 and x/net v0.55.0 reported GO-2026-6809 (crypto/x509, fixed in go1.26.10) and GO-2026-6860 (x/net, fixed in v0.62.0). The directive tracks the repo floor, now 1.26.11 for GO-2026-6859. README and SKILL install text follow that floor.
validated_outcome: `cli-printing-press publish validate` passes govulncheck and verify-skill; `go build ./...` and `go test ./...` passed on the floor in place when this patch was first applied.
